App.Title: RadarTorres — Target Detection and Tower Selection System
TopBar.NovaJanelaDica: Opens a new page with its own login screen — stay signed in as another user at the same time.
Shell.FocusMode.Tooltip: Closes other applications and disables networking to dedicate the computer to RadarTorres
Shell.FocusMode.ConfirmarAtivar: This will close other open applications and try to disable Wi-Fi/Ethernet/Bluetooth (may prompt for administrator confirmation). Continue?
Shell.FocusMode.ConfirmarDesativar: This will restore networking (Wi-Fi/Ethernet/Bluetooth). Closed applications are not reopened automatically. Continue?
Shell.FocusMode.Resumo: {0} application(s) closed, {1} could not be closed. Network: {2}
Cameras.Title: Cameras
Cameras.Visualizacao.SemImagem: The image will appear here once the preview is started.
Cameras.NenhumaEncontrada: No camera was found. Connect a webcam and click "Refresh list".
Cameras.SelecioneParaIniciar: Select a camera and click "Start preview".
Cameras.Erro.Desconectada: The camera was disconnected. Reconnect it and try again.
Cameras.Erro.Ocupada: The camera is being used by another application or could not be accessed.
Cameras.Erro.AcessoNegado: Windows denied access to the camera. Check the system's camera permissions.
Cameras.Erro.Desconhecido: The selected camera could not be displayed. Please try again.
PerfilAlvo.Descricao: Color, shape and size that the vision-based detection should lock onto. Only one profile can be active at a time.
PerfilAlvo.Foto.Descricao: Capture the object photos from one of the cameras (at least 3 to register) and mark on each one which object recognition should observe.
PerfilAlvo.Foto.SemPreview: Pick a camera to start previewing and centering the object.
PerfilAlvo.Foto.MarcarObjeto: Drag over the photo to mark the object to be observed. Recognition compares the live image with the marked region.
PerfilAlvo.Foto.SemFoto: No reference photo yet for this profile.
